title: Which Values Matter to Socially Assistive Robots in Elder Care Settings? Empirically Investigating Values That Should Be Embedded in SARs from a Multi-Stakeholder Perspective
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study grounded in Value Sensitive Design (VSD) and ethical frameworks (such as care ethics).
